issues.legal_issue: Whether the testimony of related, injured eyewitnesses, corroborated by other testimony and medical evidence, was reliable enough to establish the accused’s participation and overt acts.

Whether the evidence proved murder under Section 302 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, rather than culpable homicide not amounting to murder under Part II of Section 304 or an offence falling within an exception to Section 300.
Whether the convictions and sentences imposed on the accused warranted interference on appeal.
